guidelines.detail: same as LRN-004 (The validator reports that an element’s id is not a valid xs:ID value. This is an identifier-formatting error, not a missing-element issue, and the proposed guideline is already covered by learned guideline LRN-004.)

refines GW-04 (The description identifies paperwork, orientation, and training as onboarding steps, and says the process concludes only once all steps are completed. The missing parallel split and join records support modeling these as concurrent branches that synchronize before the outcome. GW-04 covers when to use a parallel split; this guideline clarifies the completion-dependent synchronization. The generate)

refines FID-01 (The description says candidates are invited, while the generated label substitutes selecting them; it also distinguishes the start of onboarding from the paperwork included in it. This refines FID-01 by specifying how to preserve described activity distinctions in task labels.)

refines GW-02 (The description makes the activity optional, while the reference includes gateways before and after it that are absent from the generated model. This refines the documented exclusive-split guidance by specifying how to model an optional activity.)

same as LRN-007 (The label pairs show generated activities substituting or narrowing the described action or milestone, including selection instead of invitation and completion instead of beginning. The description distinguishes the start of onboarding from its eventual completion and integration. LRN-007 already states this labeling principle.)

refines GW-03 (The description supports alternative interview paths and an optional activity, with later common continuations. The missing gateway and flows show those choices and reconnections were not modeled. This refines GW-03 by specifying when to use the exclusive merge and pairing it with the choice gateway; the optional-activity case also overlaps with learned guideline LRN-008.)

same as LRN-007 (The description distinguishes identifying the hiring need, onboarding activities, and the final integration outcome. The generated labels substitute or alter those stated meanings; LRN-007 already gives the same guidance about labeling a task with the stated action or milestone.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description is being translated into a BPMN XML model: Assign every BPMN element an id that is a valid XML Schema xs:ID value, following the XML name lexical rules, and ensure the ids are unique.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description contains multiple process elements to represent in BPMN XML

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description names multiple required activities without specifying their order and states that a later outcome depends on all of them: Model the activities as parallel branches and synchronize them before that outcome.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description names multiple required activities without specifying their order and states that a later outcome depends on all of them

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description explicitly identifies an action or process milestone at a point in the flow: Label the corresponding BPMN task with that stated action or milestone; do not substitute a related action or label only a constituent activity when the description identifies the broader milestone.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description explicitly identifies an action or process milestone at a point in the flow

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says an activity may or may not take place: Model the choice with an exclusive split: one path performs the optional activity and the other bypasses it. Rejoin the alternative paths with an exclusive merge when both continue into the same flow.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says an activity may or may not take place

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description presents mutually exclusive alternatives or says an activity may or may not occur, and the paths later continue in common: Model the choice with an exclusive gateway, and reconnect the alternative paths with an exclusive merge before their shared continuation.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description presents mutually exclusive alternatives or says an activity may or may not occur, and the paths later continue in common
